description: Implementation of PTMCoreMLCompiler class for managing CoreML model compilation and caching on iOS/macOS, including model loading, caching, and version management.

classes.name: PTMCoreMLCompiler
classes.description: Objective-C++ class for handling CoreML model compilation, caching, and loading with version control.

methods.name: setCacheDirectory
methods.description: Sets the cache directory for storing compiled models.

methods.name: cacheDirectory
methods.description: Returns the current cache directory, defaults to temporary directory if not set or not writable.

methods.name: compileModel
methods.description: Compiles a CoreML model from specifications, caches it, and manages versioning.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads a compiled CoreML model with specified backend and low precision options, with error handling.

methods.name: _writeModelSpecs
methods.description: Writes model specifications to a file in protobuf binary format.

methods.name: _compileModel
methods.description: Compiles a model at a given path and caches the compiled version.

methods.name: _cleanupCachedModel
methods.description: Removes cached model and version files for a given model name.

methods.name: _cacheURLForModel
methods.description: Generates a cache URL for a model with a specific extension.
